preparedCheck: same operator applied AFTER existing z18 PNG decoding, only already retained patch centres; no product writes

codec.note: prospective display tolerances, not a physical noise floor; preserve failures

colour.qualification: HSV defined only for source max-min>=4DN; no spectral/calibrated chromaticity claim

criteria.spatial: pointwise input-value function, constant fields stay constant; no neighbour reads/halos; monotonic intensity curve
criteria.determinism: exact RGB8 hashes, JSON and PNG rerun
criteria.runtime: constant pointwise arithmetic, no spatial context or new architecture; timings local CPU diagnostics only

selection: first (least amplitude) candidate passing ALL numerical and matched visual checks; if none, report constraints; do not tune params or thresholds
decision: C requires all checks and bounded visual legibility; B if useful legibility constrained by any material check; A if no useful improvement; D only if unavailable input/evaluation prevents conclusion
allowedClaim: display of some already-recorded source structure may improve; no new information or physical correction
thresholdRationale: 15% gradient/10% metre-contrast are modest prospective digital separability tests; cap codec amplification35%, low-range gain25%, channel rounding colour tolerance5deg/.05; these are engineering experiment tolerances, not validated human thresholds
